role: external specificity control for the Palmer performance-history result; not a colony-level replication

source.dataset: Lack of synchronized breeding success in a seabird community: extreme events, niche separation, and environmental variability

metadata_only_known_before_freeze.adelie_sampling: breeding pairs and fledged chicks recorded for the entire Pointe Geologie Adelie colony/archipelago population

scientific_question: Can a lagged breeding-success-to-growth association resembling the Palmer history signal occur at whole-population scale, where within-population colony redistribution cannot change total abundance?

logic.if_positive: A positive bias-resistant lag-2 association at the aggregate scale demonstrates that such temporal carry-over is not specific to within-colony redistribution or public-information-driven settlement; environmental persistence or demographic carry-over remain sufficient classes of explanation.
logic.if_null: A null aggregate result is compatible with greater specificity of the Palmer within-island signal, but does not prove redistribution or public-information use.

eligibility.species: Use only the Adelie penguin row series. Match species by an unambiguous dataset label containing Adelie or Pygoscelis adeliae; if no unique match, STOP.
eligibility.numeric: Require finite YEAR, ABUN, CHICKS and BS with ABUN > 0.
eligibility.duplicate_year: Fail closed if more than one eligible Adelie row exists for the same YEAR.
eligibility.time_span: Find all contiguous runs of consecutive calendar years. Primary analysis uses the longest run; ties are resolved by choosing the earliest run.
eligibility.stop_rule: If the longest eligible consecutive run contains fewer than 25 years, STOP without fitting.

audit.breeding_success_consistency: Report max absolute difference between supplied BS and CHICKS/ABUN. Do not redefine BS unless a discrepancy larger than 1e-8 is found; if larger, STOP for source audit before inference.

mechanically_coupled_lag1.role: descriptive only because BS_t = CHICKS_t/ABUN_t and g1_t shares ABUN_t

primary_bias_resistant_lag2.model: g2_t = beta2 * z(BS_t) + gamma * z(log(ABUN_{t+1})) + eta * centered_year_t + error

secondary_lag3.role: descriptive temporal persistence comparison with Palmer

inference.null: Preserve the entire observed breeding-success time series and its autocorrelation by circularly shifting BS relative to abundance/growth while keeping outcome, abundance control and calendar year fixed.
inference.allowed_shifts: All non-zero circular shifts of the complete predictor vector over the frozen longest consecutive annual span.
inference.p_value: one-sided upper-tail exact circular-shift p = (1 + number shifted beta2 >= observed beta2) / (1 + number allowed shifts)
inference.note: Because exact circular shifts are few, report the full null range and rank as well as p.

secondary_diagnostics.lag1: Report beta1 from the same control structure using ABUN_t as the size control, but do not use it for mechanism inference.
secondary_diagnostics.lag3: Report beta3 and its circular-shift rank descriptively.
secondary_diagnostics.remove_extreme_year: Identify the single year with the lowest supplied BS only after the primary result is frozen; repeat beta2 without that predictor year as a prespecified sensitivity, but do not let it replace the primary.
secondary_diagnostics.first_difference_bs: Descriptive only: regress g2_t on BS_t - BS_{t-1} for years where defined; no support decision.

decision.aggregate_carryover_supported: beta2 > 0 and exact one-sided circular-shift p <= 0.05.
decision.specificity_interpretation_if_supported: The Palmer lag-2 association cannot be treated as specific evidence of within-island redistribution/public information because a comparable carry-over exists in an aggregate population where internal redistribution leaves total abundance unchanged.
decision.specificity_interpretation_if_not_suppor: No aggregate lag-2 carry-over is detected under this control; this is compatible with but does not establish a redistribution-specific Palmer process.

claim_boundaries: This is not an external replication of the Palmer colony-level effect because the Dryad data are aggregate Pointe Geologie population data.
Do not use the mechanically coupled lag-1 endpoint as evidence for public information or demographic memory.
Do not infer individual movement from aggregate population data.
Do not tune lags, controls, consecutive-span selection, alpha, or the circular-shift null after Dryad values are opened.
A positive aggregate lag-2 effect weakens mechanistic specificity; a null result does not prove Palmer public-information use.
